process_candour: PR #542 was merged on a CLEARED merge-policy verdict before its automated reviews were read; the unaddressed P1 on it was the reason #543 and #544 exist.
The #542 topic branch was amended and pushed with --force-with-lease before it was reviewed or merged.

The first deny list claimed to mirror the declared sensitive locations but covered 6 of 16, and protected the unused default path for AWS and kube. The runtime file was applied with that 6-entry list before the gaps were found.
undeclared_candidates_not_added: CARGO_HOME credentials.toml, GRADLE_USER_HOME and CURL_HOME can hold secrets but are not in the operator's declared sensitive set; widening that set is the operator's decision.
observations: Claude Code rewrites settings.json with timeout before onFailure on the guard hooks, while the modify script emits the opposite order, so chezmoi diff shows that cosmetic churn after any app write.
The app-owned model key was absent from the runtime settings.json before the first apply; the modify script cannot remove it.
custody: All implementation is merged to origin/main of domus-genoma-private (#542 9c1088ae, #543 8e8e69f9, #544 70870811). The limen lever, test pin, receipt and this evidence are committed on the owner branch. The only local-only payloads are the per-checkout, gitignored .claude/settings.local.json and disposable scratch under the job directory; the local file's required change is specified deterministically by the jq recipe in the owner issue, so nothing unrecoverable is held only locally.
checkout_disposition: Retained by contract: the owner worktree (native anchor and receipt root) and one clean detached domus checkout at 70870811 (the subject scope). Removed this session after proving landing: three spent domus worktrees and the three local topic branches (each local tip equalled its remote tip and its merged PR head). The three remote topic branches (fix/claude-credential-read-deny-20261019, fix/claude-credential-deny-full-sensitive-list-20261019, fix/claude-credential-deny-xdg-kube-20261019) remain: deleting a remote ref is on the confirm-first list. The shared domus checkout was never mutated; it is dirty with another session's file and behind origin/main.
handoff: https://github.com/4444J99/limen/issues/3127 owns the two gated steps: the operator-named chezmoi apply of the runtime settings.json, and the jq update of the project-local settings.local.json. It is mirrored by the registry lever L-CLAUDE-CREDENTIAL-DENY-APPLY with a deterministic predicate: jq -e '.permissions.deny | length == 17' on the deployed settings.json.
